MUTUAL NON-DISCLOSURE AGREEMENT

This Agreement is made between Acme Robotics Ltd. and Borealis Analytics Inc. Each party may disclose Confidential Information to the other.

1. Definitions

1.1 Confidential Information
Confidential Information means any technical or business information disclosed by one party to the other. It does not include information that is publicly available.

1.2 Representatives
Representatives means the employees, officers and advisers of a party.

2. Obligations

2.1 Use
The Receiving Party shall use the Confidential Information only for the Purpose. The Receiving Party shall not reverse engineer any prototype.

2.2 Return
On written request the Receiving Party shall return or destroy all Confidential Information within thirty days.

3. Term

This Agreement remains in force for five years from the Effective Date. Either party may terminate it with ninety days notice.
